content:
It's time to take a look at the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases together. Apple's latest product officially began accepting pre-orders this morning, and major brands are ready. Apple has launched a range of colorful silicone cases, brand-new TechWoven fabric cases, and classic designs from several top third-party manufacturers. From a new burgundy version with a built-in stand, to models with an excellent feel and ultra-personalisation, to premium leather options from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods — there's something for everyone. Brands like Spigen also offer affordable options starting from $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Featured Partner: ESR

ESR's brand-new collection of iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories is officially here, offering premium colour options and patented technology. The standout is the new Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case, featuring a built-in zinc alloy Flex stand that integrates seamlessly with the camera bump for enhanced protection, reportedly providing 3x military-grade protection while remaining "soft, flexible, and comfortable to the touch". The new Atelier collection comes in four colours, with additional accessories to match the new burgundy, ice blue, black, and silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Case with MagSafe and Flex Stand: $42 (originally $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector: $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case: $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo MagSafe Wallet Stand Case (with Anti-Slip Grip): $46 (originally $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

The well-known premium leather case brand Nomad has prepared a complete product line for all iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max flagship models. The brand also launched a brand-new Rugged Case series this year, with each colour option featuring three-dimensional textures inspired by the Baja California peninsula:

  • Rugged Case: $70
  • Colours: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather Case: $69
  • Colours: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back: $59
  • Colours: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case: $55
  • Colours: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Grey
  • Modern Leather Case: $69 to $89
  • Traditional Leather Case: $79 to $99
  • Rugged Leather Case: $79
  • Colours: Rustic Brown

Featured Partner: Dbrand

Dbrand's popular Grip Case is ready to support the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to having one of the cleanest designs and an ultra-strong non-slip feel, it continues to offer full custom skin support this year, allowing you to add a personal touch; bundle it with the Prism screen protector for a discount.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $55. Customisable designs, drop protection, ultra non-slip, with excellent button feel.
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max), 2-pack: $35 ($5 off when purchased with a case). Easy installation, automatic alignment, completely dust-free.

Dbrand also launched a brand-new MNML case series this year, starting from $39, featuring minimalist designs and affordable prices, retaining MagSafe support while maintaining the brand's signature crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case: $39. Colours: Black, Marine, Tan, Burgundy.

  • Full Leather Case (iPhone 18 Series): $59

Burton Goods

  • Luxury Pocket Book Folio (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $89 (originally $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Duo): $60 (originally $80)

UAG

UAG also offers a range of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, featuring the brand's signature reinforced corners, non-slip edges, and rugged models with various drop-protection designs. If you're looking for a case that can withstand harsh environments while still being suitable for everyday protection, UAG's product line is definitely worth considering.

  • UAG Mouve (iPhone Duo): $65
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case (iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max): $80
  • UAG Civilian Grip Case: from $60
  • More...

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Case

If you want to equip your new phone with a rugged case but don't like common brands like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut series is well worth considering. These cases have passed MIL-STD-810H drop testing, provide reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a premium iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max case that won't make your phone too bulky, Mous is a good choice. Mous now offers ultra-thin aramid fibre cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, as well as the following models.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case: $75
  • Mous Clear Case: $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Case: $85
  • Mous Slim MagSafe Case: $55
  • Mous Slim Aramid Fibre Case: $70
  • More...

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases are known for their futuristic design, avant-garde style, and slim profile, catching the eye with unique texture treatments.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fibre Case: $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case (iPhone 18 Pro): $60
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case: $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are perfect for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users seeking an ultra-thin design. Their products are typically made from lightweight aramid fibre, featuring a clean and understated look while remaining MagSafe-compatible and providing extra protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Texture Case: $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Protection Aramid Case: $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Case: $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also offers a diverse range of case options for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, from slim everyday models to heavy-duty rugged designs, providing reliable protection. Many new models support MagSafe, and some also feature non-slip edges, accessory slots, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, allowing you to choose based on your preferred thickness and level of protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro: $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series: $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series (with Stand): $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series: $60
  • More...

Belkin

Belkin is another reliable choice for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, especially suitable for users who prefer a clean style, don't want to make their phone too bulky, but don't need a military-grade case. Their product line typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases, featuring raised screen and camera edges, with some models (such as Protect+) adding reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and a slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case: $30
  • Belkin Qi2-compatible MagSafe Case (with Anti-Slip Grip): $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case (with Air Cushion Corners): $60
